ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with small, localized high-intensity (white) circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple high-contrast white ring-shaped blobs distributed across the lateral lobes. High-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression; interior angle is approximately 135 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire visible trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude variations between 3 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, tapering upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous white circular ring constellations (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, with higher spatial density on the outer third of each lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular scars consistent with parasitic attachment; irregular jagged profile along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small clusters of white, high-intensity material adhering to the distal-most points of both fluke lobes.
